items.title: Nimbus CRM
items.description: A lead-management workspace that keeps pipelines, follow-ups and deals on one screen.
items.challenge: Sales reps juggled five tools and lost leads between hand-offs.
items.solution: A unified SaaS CRM with smart queues, email sync, role-based access and real-time reporting.
results: Single source of truth for 40+ reps

items.title: Paylane
items.description: A fintech dashboard for tracking balances, payouts and spending analytics in real time.
items.challenge: Finance teams relied on spreadsheets and delayed bank exports.
items.solution: Bank-grade dashboard with live data feeds, approval workflows and exportable reports.

items.title: FreshCart
items.description: An online grocery store with slot-based delivery, subscriptions and a lightning-fast checkout.
items.challenge: Low mobile conversion and abandoned carts on the legacy store.
items.solution: A headless storefront with one-page checkout, saved baskets and inventory-aware delivery slots.

items.title: MediQ
items.description: A patient app for booking appointments, video consults and secure prescriptions.
items.challenge: Clinics lost patients to long phone queues and no-shows.
items.solution: Cross-platform app with smart scheduling, reminders and encrypted teleconsultation.

items.title: LogiTrack ERP
items.description: An ERP that unifies fleet, warehouse, billing and reporting for a regional carrier.
items.challenge: Disconnected systems meant late invoices and no real-time fleet visibility.
items.solution: Modular ERP with live GPS tracking, automated invoicing and executive dashboards.

items.title: Auralis Assistant
items.description: An AI support assistant that resolves common customer questions and hands off the rest.
items.challenge: Support tickets doubled in a year with no budget for new agents.
items.solution: An LLM-powered assistant trained on the help center, wired into orders and the ticketing system.

items.title: Stayloop
items.description: A travel booking platform with live availability, maps and flexible itineraries.
items.challenge: Slow search and unclear pricing were hurting bookings.
items.solution: Fast faceted search, transparent pricing and a mobile-first booking flow.

items.title: BrightPath Academy
items.description: A learning app with live classes, quizzes and progress tracking for K-12 students.
items.challenge: Students dropped off from long, passive video lessons.
items.solution: Bite-sized lessons, gamified streaks and a teacher dashboard for real-time insights.
